title: Schneider Electric IGSSdataServer Exposed Dangerous Function Data Deletion Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to delete application-level data on affected installations of Schneider Electric IGSS. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the IGSSdataServer process, which listens on TCP port 12401 by default. The issue results from the exposure of a dangerous function. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to delete application-specific data.
